concept.title: Browser Policy Manager overview
concept.shortdesc: Browser Policy Manager helps you create, review, validate, save, and export Firefox enterprise policy profiles.

section.title: What BPM does
section.p: Use BPM to configure Firefox policies and managed preferences, choose a supported Firefox schema, apply CIS layers, inspect validation results, and exchange policy JSON. The guide covers the Guided, All settings, JSON, library, comparison, and review workflows.

section.title: Use the documentation
section.p: The portal is available in English, Russian, German, Simplified Chinese, French, and Spanish. Its deterministic local search and filters find published topics, stable policy identifiers, CIS recommendations, and API operations. Search remains available independently of the assistant.

section.title: Documentation assistant training notice
section.p: For every submitted chat question, BPM shows a localized training notice rather than a generated answer, source list, or external-search result.
The chat and deterministic documentation search are separate: the supported search, filters, navigation and result order remain available for all current product information.

section.title: Open the assistant
section.p: The collapsed BPM AI Assistant entry is in the lower-right corner of every documentation page. Open it to use a floating panel rather than a sidebar. On a desktop it is about half of the viewport wide and 90 percent of the visible viewport high. The panel keeps the title, question field, and bottom status row visible while the chat transcript scrolls.

section.title: Ask and manage a conversation
section.p: Enter any question and send it to view the localized training notice. Use Clear conversation to remove the current chat. It is not a BPM answer and must not be used to configure or validate a policy.
Within one browser tab and documentation language, the open or collapsed state and completed notice messages remain available after reload or documentation navigation.

section.title: Current product boundary
section.p: BPM does not provide model installation, retrieval indexing, generated answers, citations, or external sources. Use deterministic documentation search for current information.
